name: Vietnamese

tutor.name: Linh
tutor.personality: cheerful, explains tones with patience, corrects pronunciation gently

notes: Vietnamese uses the Latin alphabet with additional diacritics to indicate tones and modified vowels. It has 6 tones that distinguish word meaning, and is an analytic language with no inflection.
